proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access planar destination restriction/override
proposed_widenings.justification: The existing magic-item activation family and charge-cast spell grant fit, but the surface cannot express that casts of Gate and Plane Shift made through this item must use the plane keyed to the pressed cube face rather than the spell's normal unrestricted destination choice.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "Gate. Pressing one side of the cube, you cast Gate, opening a portal to the plane of existence keyed to that side." / "Plane Shift. Pressing one side of the cube twice, you cast Plane Shift, transporting the targets to the plane of existence keyed to that side."

notes: Did not author content/magic_item_cubic_gate.dhall. Encoding it as a generic Gate/Plane Shift grant would be materially false because the keyed-face destination restriction is the item's core mechanic.
